overview_description.description: Cura is a Saudi leading virtual hospital and telehealth provider that provides digital health and telemedicine software and services. The company has developed state-of-the-art technologies to empower health communications, changing the way patients and doctors interact, diagnose, prescribe, give second opinions, manage chronic diseases, and provide primary health care and well-being therapy sessions. For more information: https://cura.healthcare/en/

product.name: Online Medical Consultation
product.description: A service providing immediate or same-day online consultations with licensed doctors across various medical specialties.

product.name: Health Care Programs
product.description: Pre-designed therapeutic and wellness programs aimed at addressing specific health goals and conditions through scheduled sessions.

product.name: Psychological and Psychiatric Services
product.description: Specialized mental health services including therapy, counseling, and psychiatric consultations for various psychological disorders.

product.name: Medical Specialty Consultations
product.description: Access to consultations with specialists across a broad range of medical fields including internal medicine, surgery, pediatrics, and more.

product.name: Nutrition and Diet Programs
product.description: Programs focused on dietary management and nutrition counseling to support weight control and specific diet plans.
